selection_basis: Metadata only: Office, Education, Food sales and service, Manufacturing/industrial, Lodging/residential; lexicographically first building_id within each use, excluding Byron. No outcomes or previous transfer metrics consulted.
primary_protocol: early_only: target fitting uses only first 45 days; CQR/risk calibration uses final 10 early days (Feb5-14), recomputed for each frozen monthly source expert. State frozen within month; NO test outcomes enter any fit. This is NOT adaptive daily10 deployment and measures calibration staleness deliberately.
secondary_protocol: daily_past10: exact deployed daily10 CQR/risk/width rules via generic single-building fit_local+issued; completed target observations strictly before origin day may update calibration, including past test observations. Separately labeled prequential online evaluation, NEVER pooled with primary or used for model_card cross_building_coverage.
source_models: Existing monthly artifact for target calendar month; verify index SHA256, version and train_end<month_start; freeze point, scale and quantiles. Target feature lags are observed before target hour (rolling one-step, NOT open-loop forecast). No scaling, tuning, cold-start correction or target point retraining.
self_baseline: Same source artifact cfg/features/expanded US holidays and LightGBM hyperparameters; train point and quantiles Jan1-21; fit scale on first65% of Jan22-Feb4; CQR/risk local calibration Feb5-14. Point/scale/quantiles fixed for rest of year; both protocols use identical test hours and calibration policy. Source has longer Byron history, so this is a limited-history self-trained comparator, not a full-history upper bound.
metric_definition: all_coverage over all issued test rows; retained_coverage/retained_mae only final gate-passed rows (risk AND width); CV(RMSE)=RMSE/mean(observed target test load), fraction; undefined if mean=0; MAE in source hourly kWh. Pool coverage by counts, not building-average. Also report gate reasons, widths, seasonal/holiday/low-load diagnostics.
immutability: Write this plan before any fit/score. Store plan/data/source artifact hashes and runtime versions; never replace selected buildings or retune after scoring. Existing results refuse overwrite.
scope: Offline evaluation, model-card export and tests only; no dashboard, QA/chat or API changes; multi_horizon cross_building_coverage remains null.
